questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed coherent parity oscillations? The paper presents one device, in at least two cooldowns.
Why were the others set aside?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: other values or directions of the parallel field than 150 mT, higher temperatures, and hybrid-gate and dot detunings wider than in Fig. 3c-g and Fig. 4?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like? Fig. ED9 lacks the odd-manifold check; how many sweet spots did you find, and did any other pass the even and odd comparison?
Methods XI says the frequency difference in Fig. 3b depends on the product of both chains' overlaps. Can you bound each chain's overlap separately, for example from φ ≈ π data in the main cooldown?
How is "about 5%" defined for Fig. 3b, which VC points fall outside it, and was each even and odd pair measured right after the same retuning?

Fig. 2e follows a charge jump "after which the device displayed increased instability" (p. 24). Which other figures came after it, and does Fig. ED7o, taken before, show the same suppression near φ = π after the 2.5 mT shift?
For the charge-qubit comparison in Fig. 4g,h, what coherence time and frequency do you find for the effective double dot at its own charge degeneracy, with the same pulses and readout?
